API ReferenceZIdentity APIUsersUsers Ops Add
Users Ops Add
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/users

Creates a new user using the provided details.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
loginName
string
REQUIRED

Unique login name of the user.

Possible values: <= 255 characters

displayName
string
REQUIRED

Display name of the user.

Possible values: <= 255 characters

firstName
string

First name of the user.

Possible values: <= 255 characters

lastName
string

Last name of the user.

Possible values: <= 255 characters

primaryEmail
string
REQUIRED

Primary email address of the user.

Possible values: <= 255 characters

secondaryEmail
string

Secondary email address of the user.

Possible values: <= 255 characters

department
object
status
boolean
REQUIRED

Whether the API user needs to be active true or disabled false.

customAttrsInfo
object
Responses
​
202
401

The request has been accepted for processing, but processing has not yet completed.
